title: HAKUNA MATATA FESTIVAL – Sunshine Edition
description:
🌞 HAKUNA MATATA – SUNSHINE EDITION 🌞
Get ready for an unforgettable weekend filled with Kizomba, music, dance, sunshine and good vibes! ☀️🔥
📅 29 January – 1 February 2027
📍 Studio G – 38400 Saint-Martin-d’Hères, France
Hakuna Matata – Sunshine Edition brings together an amazing line-up of DJs, artists and dancers for a weekend dedicated to sharing, connection and the love of dance.
🎧 DJs
DJ Diablo • DJ Miky Mike • DJ Dedinho • DJ Chad • DJ Jkee • DJ Stompy • DJ Lass
💃 Artists & Dancers
Pao Lou & Margaux • Pidjay & Enora • Heneco & Mame • Lna Carla
Expect great music, incredible dancing, beautiful energy and unforgettable moments all weekend long. 🌴✨
Whether you’re coming to learn, dance, meet new people or simply enjoy the atmosphere, Hakuna Matata – Sunshine Edition is the place to be!
☀️ Dance. Music. Sunshine. Good vibes.
Hakuna Matata! 🌺
